PreceptDef.label: personal choice
PreceptDef.description: Leadership carries no expectation about body size.

PreceptDef.label: ample
PreceptDef.description:
Leaders and moral guides should embody the colony's abundance.

Expected size: about 2.07x the fixed race baseline (145 kg for humans).
New role holders have five days of grace. Afterwards, each undersized holder gives followers -1 mood, up to -2. Vacant roles add no penalty.
Extra meals still follow personal preference.
